data: Modern day Storytelling: An introduction to documentary filmmaking and its use in peoples and environmental movements

Documentary films are modern, technology driven storytelling. A medium that can turn anyone’s life and its stories into interesting visual narrations. This course follows the journey of the camera from being a tool that exudes aesthetics, creativity, and capturing of memories, to becoming the strongest instrument of resistance in the struggles of ordinary people. Through a series of interactive lectures the students will explore how the medium of documentary filmmaking can bring stories that are invisibilised, to light. 
At the core of documentary filmmaking lies the critical concept of integrity, the ability to visually capture stories of people and the world just as we see it. Hence, this course will allow students to not only immerse themselves in historicity, but also develop ethics in practice.
Visiting Faculty, Literature and The Arts
